p:name.p:baseName: J. A. Plast Rigid abutment / flashing - Apron (RA9)

p:dataSetInformation.common:generalComment: J.A. Plast pultrygninger, hængselrygninger og formstykker til afslutning af rygning eller mod væg og skorsten.

p:technology.p:technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProces:
Foreground system: No green electricity or biogas certificates (GOs) are used to model the energy in this LCA study. The electricity in the foreground system (product stage, modules A1-A3) is modelled based on the Danish residual electricity mix from 2022. Background system: Upstream and downstream processes are modelled using national energy mixes.
Technical information can be obtained by contacting the manufacturer or on the manufacturer’s website: https://japlast.com/
p:technology.p:technologicalApplicability: J.A. Plast Rigid abutment / flashing products, as mono ridge, hinge ridge and apron, is used to finish the ridge as apron against wall or chimney. The products are permanently integrated in the building as a part of the building envelope.
